# Premium Car Wash — Bengaluru

## What we do (services)

- **Premium Car Wash** — snow-foam hand wash, high-pressure rinse, tyre dressing, streak-free showroom finish.
- **Full Car Detailing** — complete inside-out restoration: polish, wax, trim care, engine bay, spotless cabin.
- **Bike Wash (Inside & Outside)** — gentle foam wash for two-wheelers, chain degreasing, plastic polish, rust-protection spray.
- **Interior Deep Clean** — industrial vacuum cleaner, seat shampoo & extraction, dashboard detailing, odour-free sanitisation.
